description:
TUNG TUNG TUNG — TIME TO RESTOCK, KING.

Welcome to the most unhinged supermarket sim on the internet. You're not just a cashier… you're a shelf-stocking legend, a price-tagging warlord, and a mop-wielding menace. Fill aisles. Hunt deals. Beat time. Don’t let the customers cook.

From the minds of the meme multiverse comes a retail experience powered by chaos, cardboard, and questionable physics.
-Speedrun deliveries.
-Fight cart traffic.
-Unlock suspiciously powerful instant noodles.
 No rules. No refunds. Just TUNG.
name: TUNG SAHUR Supermarket Simulator
intro: Bang the drums, stock the shelves, dominate the deals!
